page_title: WOL 0-1 HEI | Wolfsburg v Heidenheim 29/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Bastian Dankert has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' Budu Zivzivadze (Heidenheim) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
90+3' Lukas Nmecha (Wolfsburg) has tested the patience of referee Bastian Dankert and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+2' Lukas Nmecha (Wolfsburg) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
90+1' Heidenheim take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) will replace Niklas Dorsch.

90' A big opportunity is wasted by Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim), who makes a yard for himself and produces a mid-range rocket of a shot towards the top right corner. Unfortunately for him, Kamil Grabara pulls off a fantastic save to stop the effort.
89' Lukas Nmecha (Wolfsburg) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes narrowly wide of the left post! What a huge opportunity!
85' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
84' Wolfsburg take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
82' Today's match ends for Kilian Fischer who will be replaced by Kevin Behrens (Wolfsburg).
78' The substitution has been made. Paul Wanner (Heidenheim) has replaced Adrian Beck.
78' Here is a change. Frans Kratzig is going off and Frank Schmidt gives the last tactical orders to Luca Kerber (Heidenheim).

77' Lukas Nmecha (Wolfsburg) beats a couple of players and hammers in a low shot from mid-range towards the middle of the goal. The keeper is caught unaware but still pulls off a great save to deny the effort. Wolfsburg will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
77' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Wolfsburg comes to nothing.

77' Lukas Nmecha (Wolfsburg) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous low effort towards the middle of the goal is blocked by Kevin Muller, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
73' Bastian Dankert shows a yellow card to Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) for his blatant foul.
73' The attendance is 21545.
70' 4:8 – the total goal attempt statistics.
68' A precise low pass is received by Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well wide of the left post.
67' Frans Kratzig (Heidenheim) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
66' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Marnon Busch as he is replaced by Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim).
63' Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
61' A substitution has been made. Andreas Skov Olsen goes off and Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg) comes on.
61' Ralph Hasenhuttl has decided to substitute Bence Dardai and he is replaced by Lukas Nmecha (Wolfsburg).
60' Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
59' The game is interrupted now, Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
57' Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) will take the corner.

57' Budu Zivzivadze (Heidenheim) decided to shoot after receiving a sweet pass. The ball went low to the middle of the goal, but Kamil Grabara made a easy save. The linesman points to the corner flag, Heidenheim are going to take it.
56' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
51' Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
51' That's a clear yellow card. Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) goes into the book.
51' The referee awards a corner and Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) goes over to take it.
48' Good work from Heidenheim as they win a corner.

48' Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Kamil Grabara makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the right side of the goal. The ball goes out of play. Heidenheim are awarded a corner kick.
46' Ralph Hasenhuttl prepares a substitution. Tiago Tomas is replaced by Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+8' The match has reached half-time.
45+6' Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
45+5' A long pass, executed by Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
45+4' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
45' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
45' A pass from Andreas Skov Olsen (Wolfsburg) is intercepted by Kevin Muller and the move breaks down.
44' The free kick from long range, taken by Wolfsburg, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
43' Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Bastian Dankert had an easy-decision to make.
42' Tim Siersleben (Heidenheim) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
40' One of the players from Heidenheim times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
37' Frans Kratzig (Heidenheim) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
37' Neat passing move from Heidenheim in order to create new attacking opportunities.
36' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
35' Budu Zivzivadze (Heidenheim) commits a foul and Bastian Dankert immediately signals a free kick.
33' Close effort! Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) takes the resulting free kick from a promising distance, but he sends it narrowly wide of the right post.
33' Another situation results in a direct free kick for Wolfsburg.
32' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Tim Siersleben (Heidenheim) was quite harsh and Bastian Dankert didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

32' Bence Dardai (Wolfsburg) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
26' Ralph Hasenhuttl is forced to make a change. Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Denis Vavro.
25' Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
23' That was a poorly executed free kick from long distance. Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) was trying to produce a cross into the penalty area, but his effort sailed off the pitch.
23' A clumsy foul by Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) and Bastian Dankert blows his whistle.

22' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
21' Great teamplay by Wolfsburg as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
16' 0 - 1 Goal! Kamil Grabara gets a hand on the penalty from Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim), but can't stop it from flying into the bottom left corner.
15' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) is going to take the penalty!

14' Poor challenge! Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) is penalised for tripping and Bastian Dankert blows his whistle. The referee blows his whistle and awards Heidenheim a penalty after chaos inside the box.
13' Andreas Skov Olsen (Wolfsburg) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Kevin Muller intercepts the ball.
10' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
8' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Heidenheim.
7' A long pass, executed by Marnon Busch (Heidenheim), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
5' The Wolfsburg players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
2' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Heidenheim will kick the game off.
